subject: alt-f
title: C.CONT.------ALT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 345 (PCC-29). ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the subject; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: GRAD (gradualism). From GRAD: STF (source transfer). From STF: ALT-F and SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). POL-P (political policies) is on a dotted line from SOC-RT-P. From POL-P: AFL (affinity alignment) and CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus). From CULT-INFO-F: PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
